from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_original_producer_price_competing_causes_joint_cases_v1'
P=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_fund_population_joint_nonlinear_increment_v1/next_experiment.json'
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已有固定登记，不能覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False),encoding='utf-8')
proposal=readj(P)
assert proposal['experiment_id']=='E108' and proposal['status']=='PROPOSED_NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN'
for r in proposal['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/r['path'])==r['sha256'],'原父事实改变：'+r['path']
assert not (OUT/'protocol.json').exists(),'已登记，不重复启动'
oldprice=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_history_acquisition_v1/本地制造业价格候选_旧用途核对与不重开裁决.json'
assert oldprice.exists()
queries=[]
for period,title in [('2020M10','2020年10月份'),('2021M07','2021年7月份'),('2024M04','2024年4月份')]:
 queries.append({'economic_period':period,'role':'NATIVE_PRICE_RELEASE','query':'site:stats.gov.cn '+title+'工业生产者出厂价格 购进价格','primary_domain':'stats.gov.cn','maximum_primary_raw_carriers':1})
 queries.append({'economic_period':period,'role':'NATIVE_OFFICIAL_CAUSE_INTERPRETATION','query':'site:stats.gov.cn 董莉娟 解读 '+title+' CPI PPI','primary_domain':'stats.gov.cn','maximum_primary_raw_carriers':1})
OUT.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
admission={'at':now(),'previous_goal_turn_classification':'PROGRESS_E105_FULL_29_FUND_SOURCES_E106_ONE_FIXED_NONLINEAR_REJECTED_E107_SAVED_FAILURE_DIAGNOSTIC','root_consecutive_blocked_goal_turns':0,'old_PMI_price_purpose_receipt':oldprice.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'old_PMI_price_purpose_receipt_sha256':sha(oldprice),'old_use':'原PMI出厂/主要原材料购进感受指数价差、售价走强/成本回落/两者同降加订单已研究失败；不把它们换成非线性或日频重开。','different_current_question':'国家统计局原工业生产者实际价格调查的出厂/购进总体及原分组与原官方当期原因，原统计对象/取价方法/分类量纲和PMI企业回答感受指数不同。只补竞争原因识别观察，不为金融表达换PPI列救回。','new_financial_candidates':0,'new_model_fits':0,'source_code_edits':0,'E100_E106_old_PMI_price_and_quarterly_flow_failures_preserved':True}
save('旧价格感受方向与本原价格调查原因问题准入.json',admission)
protocol={'study_id':'510300_ORIGINAL_PRODUCER_PRICE_COMPETING_CAUSES_JOINT_CASES_V1','experiment_id':'E108','status':'REGISTERED_THREE_FIXED_ORIGINAL_PRICE_AND_CAUSE_SOURCE_CASES_BEFORE_NEW_SOURCE_READ','registered_at':now(),'proposal_path':P.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'proposal_sha256':sha(P),'parents':proposal['parents']+[{'path':oldprice.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':sha(oldprice)}],'fixed_cases':proposal['fixed_cases'],'question':proposal['question'],'hypothesis':proposal['hypothesis'],'different_information_admission':(OUT/'旧价格感受方向与本原价格调查原因问题准入.json').relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'fixed_queries':queries,'source_selection':'六条固定stats.gov.cn定位查询各一次；每角色只选实际返回的标题/原月份相符、带自己原公开钟的官方原全文，最多一GET。重复或wrong月不换别源/不追加查询；原表与解释同载体则只GET一次复用。','source_gate':'保存完整HTML和正文/原表/全部相关附注，自己原公布时间须不晚于各原截止。保留价格调查对象与分类/环比/同比/累计平均范围；正文数量及表相互对应。archiveURL日期不作原公布钟；原文件名/当前取得钟不能证明原发布或真正首版。','source_fetch_policy':{'source_locator_queries':6,'primary_raw_GETs_max':6,'per_case_max_raw_carriers':2,'per_role_max_raw_GET':1,'request_attempts':1,'retries':0,'alternate_carrier_rescue':0,'redirects_follow_same_request':True,'authentication':0,'TLS_verification':True,'connect_timeout_seconds':12,'read_timeout_seconds':30},'joint_output':'三个原共同截止，把E102原工业量/原因/老八/问卷与E104有年龄基金完整门类并列，加入自己原PPI出厂/购进总体和相关分组/原因；每期主机制及最多两个竞争解释，分别原支持/反证/冲突/未知及官方归因/推断，重叠因素不强制单原因。','unknown_policy':'无原字段、原钟、实际现金、预期差或细行业映射均UNKNOWN；未知不补0，不按股价方向挑月份或反向解释。','point_in_time_policy':'原经济期、原载体显示公布钟、原共同决策截止、当前取得钟分开；当时可知支持与真正首版认证分开。若解释晚于原截止，原共同状态不准入它。','budget':{'new_financial_candidates':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_labels_generated':0,'financial_labels_read':False,'new_full_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'authenticated_requests':0},'stop':'完成固定六定位及最多六首GET后结束来源路线；不重试/换月/换来源/追加有利例子/参数救回。缺保留UNKNOWN。仅三例不取得79/1711/1212新金融源门，金融预算0。','previous_frozen_rejections_preserved':True,'exact_E103_target_month_index_bridge_0_of_3_preserved':True,'original79_1711_1212_identities_preserved':True,'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False,'independent_validation':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','goal_achieved':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','orders_authorized':False,'prospective_forecasts':False}
save('protocol.json',protocol)
print('已登记三原期价格及官方原因的联合来源检验：六固定定位、最多六首GET、零模型/标签/账户/源码修改。',flush=True)
